record_scope: All live checker runs used generated full capture-body manifests; no fixed TX IDs or cloud IP
capabilities: Custom env, repeated Compose files, project names and hospital service names
Three live health probes from inside the selected application container
Hospital identity, queue counts, automatic-loop configuration and freshness
Optional metadata-only or complete expected applied records
Cloud database queried in read-only transaction with parameterized expected IDs
Safe JSON reports without payloads, credentials or raw exception text
Report overwrite rejected before any Docker probes

coverage: Shared manifest filtering and custom project config
Stale, disabled and partially reachable automatic recovery
Credential URL and recovery error redaction
No-overwrite and invalid options before probes

limitations: Local disposable Docker integration, not a new AWS deployment/session
Native Linux host networking awaits CI after push
Health-only runs skip event verification unless expectations supplied
No controller, lost-ACK, partition or performance claim
